title.narrative: Cooperative Legal and Regulatory Frameworks Consultations in Africa

description.narrative:
200-Word Summary ICA-Africa, in collaboration with its sectoral entities, thematic committees, networks, and development partners such as We Effect and UN agencies, aims to advance cooperative development across East Africa and the continent. The overall objective is to create an enabling environment that supports cooperative business growth. The project seeks to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of cooperatives by improving legal frameworks, promoting inclusivity, and fostering an agro-economic system grounded in data and evidence. Key strategies include popularizing the Cooperative Model Law, advocating for policy reviews, and engaging policymakers through regional and continental platforms such as the Africa Ministerial Cooperative Conference. The initiative will support the establishment of gender and youth cooperative platforms, promote environmentally sustainable agricultural cooperatives, and increase visibility of the cooperative model through media campaigns and an improved website. ICA-Africa will also facilitate the publication of an annual African Cooperative Status Report to strengthen advocacy.
Expected outcomes include greater harmonization of cooperative laws across Africa, stronger political commitment, and the integration of cooperatives into national and continental policies. The project will enhance women and youth participation, build resilient agricultural cooperatives, and elevate recognition of the cooperative model as a driver of socio-economic development. The annual report will provide evidence-based insights to support continued advocacy.
